messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell doctor about vitamins"
set: ["tell doctor about vitamins", "vitamins", "tell doctor about minerals", "tell doctor about thoughts about suicide", "tell doctor about all medications", "tell doctor about herbal products", "includes vitamins", "tell doctor about all medical conditions", "tell doctor about all prescription medications", "tell doctor about all other medicines", "tell doctor about all current medicines", "tell doctor about all over-the-counter medications", "tell your doctor about all current medicines", "tell doctor about history of heart disease", "tell doctor about history of narrow-angle glaucoma", "tell healthcare provider if taking vitamins or herbal supplements"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
